note: Which Gemini voice speaks for each character, and how. 'style' tells the speech model how to speak; it is never read aloud. Change a voice here after listening to the audition, then re-run the generator for that speaker with: npm run narration -- --redo-speaker "Butil"

pacing.note: Google free tier for gemini-3.8-flash-tts: 10 requests per day (Google error message, 17 November 2026). A run stops by itself at the limit and continues where it left off next time. Google shows current limits at https://ai.dev/rate-limit (sign in). To fit the limit, up to 10 lines of one speaker go in one request and are cut apart afterwards (linesPerRequest).

Butil.style: warm, cheerful and gentle, speaking slowly and very clearly to a three-year-old child, with small pauses between phrases

Teacher Liza.style: a kind teacher speaking slowly and very clearly to a three-year-old child, saying the word once with a friendly tone

Lola Auring.style: an older, gentle grandmother telling a story slowly and softly to a small child
